title: eruca sativa subsp. aurea
intro: Eruca sativa subsp. aurea, commonly known as golden mustard, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion, as well as its potential to act as an antioxidant and antimicrobial agent. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of golden mustard are also believed to have a positive effect on the cardiovascular system and may help to protect against neurodegenerative diseases.
